submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution (0.834 ns) among all evaluated candidates and gap sizes. This option outperforms all other combinations while adhering to all specified constraints, including the GWP100 limit and allowed gap range. The choice is also aligned with the simulation results that show a clear minimum in time resolution for Mixture-G1 at 2 mm.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is one of the three candidate mixtures evaluated.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150, as required by the laboratory's environmental policy.
requirements.evidence: Project documents state that all three candidate mixtures were pre-screened for GWP100 < 150.
Selected gap is 2 mm, which is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: 0.834 ns at Mixture-G1, 2 mm, is the minimal value across all results.
